CITY OF ALHAMBRA DESIGN REVIEW BOARD
  MINUTES
  Regular Meeting
  March 22, 2022

  •  CALL MEETING TO ORDER: 7:30 P.M. via video conference and teleconference

  •  ROLL CALL:
  Present: Ankit Udani, Michael Daninger, Stanley Tsai
  •  Absent: Nora Hernandez, Jose Luis Espinoza
  Staff Present: Richard Abe AIA, Vist Yang

CONSENT AGENDA

All items on the consent agenda will be addressed under a single motion unless a Design
Review Board Member or a member of the public requests that the item be heard under the
Discussion Agenda.

ITEM 1: MINUTES: March 8, 2022

MOTION:
 •  Daninger moved to approve the consent agenda as submitted.
 •  The second was by Tsai.
 •  The motion carried 3-0 with the following roll call vote:

  1
 There were no comments from the applicant.

Daninger has no design comments.

Tsai questioned why the fence was setback from the property line.

The applicant stated that it was to avoid the footings of the light fixtures.

Tsai questioned if they could provide landscape. The applicant stated that due to the topography it
would be difficult. But there are trees on site.

Udani confirmed that the fence will be painted black to match the fence across the street owned by
the same owner.

MOTION:
 •  Daninger moved to approve the application with the following conditions: 1. The applicant
  shall revise the fence detailing to be code compliant; and 2. All revised drawings shall be
  reviewed and approved by DRB staff prior to permit issuance.
 •  The second was by Tsai.
 •  The motion carried 3-0 with the following roll call vote:

Ayes: Ankit Udani, Stanley Tsai, Michael Daninger
Absent: Nora Hernandez, Jose Luis Espinoza

ITEM 3: 234 South Curtis Avenue

RECOMMENDED ACTION: Recommendation is for approval with the following conditions: 1.
The materials and colors shall be revised for better integration with the building massing and
context; and 2. All revisions are subject to review by DRB staff prior to Planning Commission
review.

The applicant Henry Ho gave a brief presentation with a revised color palette in response to the
staff comments.

Daninger stated that he had a concern over the misalignment of the window on the second floor.
There was discussion on the consistency of the drawings and the appropriateness of aligning key
windows. He was accepting of the new color scheme.

Udani concurred with the comments about window alignment and the revised color palette was
much improved.

Tsai questioned the street elevation. The colored elevation has a discrepancy with the floor plan.
Discussion ensued regarding 2 versions of the plans and that the City's set may be the previous
version. He also confirmed that the canopy thickness will be one foot. He questioned the detailing

  2
 for the intersection between the hardiboard and the stucco. Discussion ensued regarding metal
flashing and appropriate transitions.Tsai expressed his concern over the functional issue. The
applicant stated that would be addressed in production.

Daninger stated that on the north elevation he stated a minor discrepancy at the north elevations.
Clarification was made that the center door is an entry but the two side panels are not doors but
full height fixed windows. Daninger further stated that the jamb of the door on the left side could
be increased in width.

Udani questioned the site plan and a definition of a portion of landscape labeled common space.
The applicant stated that it would be a mixture of landscape and hardscape in this common area.

Tsai questioned where the AC units would be located. Applicant stated it would be on the second
floor balconies of each unit.

MOTION:
 •  Tsai moved to approve the application with the following conditions: 1. The applicant shall
  revise the submittal with the newly revised color and materials palette; 2. The applicant
  shall work with staff on minor architectural window and door detailing and alignment; and
  3. All revised drawings shall be reviewed and approved by DRB staff prior to permit
  issuance.
 •  The second was by Daninger.
 •  The motion carried 3-0 with the following roll call vote:

  3
 MOTION:
 •  Daninger moved to approve the application with the following conditions: 1. The applicant
  shall remove the awning in its entirety when either one or both spaces are leased; and 2.
  All revised drawings shall be reviewed and approved by DRB staff prior to permit
  issuance.
 •  The second was by Tsai.
 •  The motion carried 3-0 with the following roll call vote:

Ayes: Ankit Udani, Stanley Tsai, Michael Daninger
Absent: Nora Hernandez, Jose Luis Espinoza

ADJOURNMENT:
MOTION:
 •  Daninger moved to adjourn the meeting at 8:20
 •  Seconded by Tsai
 •  The motion carried 3-0 by the following roll call vote:

Ayes: Ankit Udani, Stanley Tsai, Michael Daninger
Absent: Nora Hernandez, Jose Luis Espinoza

PASSED, APPROVED AND ADOPTED this 12th day of April, 2022.

  _____________________
  Ankit Udani, Chairman

ATTEST:

_____________________________
Steve Kuchenski
Secretary/City Architect
